site.title: Conduit
site.summary: Secure, self-hosted observability for AI agents: traces, logs and metrics over mTLS, stored in ClickHouse and VictoriaMetrics, with a server-rendered UI. Go services, Go and Python SDKs.

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: What Conduit is, its highlights, and where to start.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.description: Components, data flow, delivery and failure guarantees, storage schema (spans, logs, metrics), schema migrations, sensitive data.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.description: Docker Compose and Kubernetes setup, health checks, upgrades, and the configuration reference (every environment variable).

pages.title: Security
pages.description: Threat model, mTLS agent identity, ingestion rate limiting, UI authentication (login form or GCP IAP), browser hardening.

pages.title: Examples
pages.description: Runnable Go and Python agents (hello-trace, tool calling, asyncio, Claude, OpenAI) that send traces to a local quickstart in one command.

pages.title: Go SDK
pages.description: Instrument a Go agent: spans, status, LLM calls, logs, gauges and counters; API table and limits.

pages.title: Python SDK
pages.description: Instrument a Python agent: context-manager spans (thread- and asyncio-safe), logs, metrics; API table and limits.

pages.title: API reference
pages.description: The gRPC ingestion API (IngestSpan, IngestBatch): every message, field and enum, authentication, partial-acceptance errors, and the exact validation limits the gateway enforces. Generated from the .proto files and the source.

pages.title: Roadmap
pages.description: What has shipped, what is Now / Next / Later, and open decisions awaiting a maintainer.

pages.title: Releasing
pages.description: Versioning policy, verifying signed images (cosign, SBOM, provenance), upgrading, and how to cut a release.

pages.title: Contributing
pages.description: Development setup, required checks, code generation, schema migrations, conventions, and the PR process.

pages.title: Brand
pages.description: Logo usage, color palette, and WCAG contrast rules for the UI.
